card.name: Removing caps from prefilled syringes
card.fires_on: The word right after a remove or pull-off verb in syringe and autoinjector instructions, such as the, tip, plastic or it, just before a cap or cover is named.

modes.label: Remove the + part
modes.description: The article or modifier after Remove, leading into the name of a cap or syringe part.
modes.example: Pre-filled syringe Remove<< the>> tip cap of the syringe, screw

modes.label: Cap-type word
modes.description: Words like tip or plastic that describe the cap being removed from a syringe or needle.
modes.example: - Remove the<< plastic>> needle cap by pulling it straight off.

card.writes: It seems to push toward assembly and handling verbs and away from stacking or placing words.
card.plain: It lights up in device instructions when the text says to remove or pull off a syringe cap or cover.
